text:
mira (design): Quick thread: compacting the latency toolbar. Goal: reduce vertical height and surface most-used controls. Proposed: presets (30s/1m/5m/30m), a tiny "custom" chevron that opens the full picker, and a collapsed "sampling" pill that expands to a micro-slider. Sketch in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc. liam (frontend): Love the compact approach. Two questions: (1) how should the pill indicate it's changed from default? (2) do we animate the expand/collapse? Tiny animation avoids layout jump. noor (eng): From infra side, sampling toggles affect aggregation pipeline. We need the sampling state in URL + event so caches and alerts don't mismatch. Also recommend debounce on slider updates (250ms). carmen (pm): Use cases: support quick triage (fast presets) and deeper analysis (custom). Default sampling should be 25% for orgs to limit cost. We should log preset vs custom to decide later. ravi (a11y): Accessibility notes: presets must be reachable via keyboard with a single tab stop that opens a popover list (role=listbox). The sampling pill must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls when expanded. Slider needs aria-valuetext, and live region updates when the chart re-renders to announce new time window. Contrast: the tiny legend chips on dark theme fail WCAG AA at small sizes. mira (design): Proposed affordance for changed state: a subtle dot on the pill + updated label like "Sampling • 10%". Expand would be animated with scaleY to keep layout stable. liam (frontend): Implementation sketch: ```
[30s] [1m] [5m] [30m]
Sampling • 25%
``` Panel contains `` with `aria-valuetext="Sampling: 25%"`. Will debounce network calls. noor (eng): Fine. Add query param `?sampling_pct=25` and event `latency_sampling_change`. Also add telemetry for `preset_click` with preset_id. carmen (pm): Short tooltip copy options for the pill: (A) "Sampling reduces cost; may hide short spikes." (B) "Lower sampling reduces detail but saves compute." Ravi: which is clearer? ravi (a11y): Option A is clearer. Also make tooltip accessible: role="tooltip", dismissible with Escape, and ensure screen readers get the updated detail when sampling changes (aria-live="polite"). deploy-bot: Deploy note: feature-branch latency-toolbar pushed at 1965012330 by liam. liam (frontend): UI nit: at very low sampling (<=5%) the heatmap cells become thin vertical lines. Suggest a low-density overlay: an inline badge "low sampling — expect noise" and a dashed pattern in cells (helps colorblind users). mira (design): Good call on the pattern. We'll test pattern + the overlay badge for discoverability. Also keep p95 always visible (small pill to the right) so the user's eye lands on it first. noor (eng): Performance note: calculate p95 server-side when range changes; cache result for 1s to avoid thrash. Good to keep it separate for rendering. carmen (pm): Decision: ship v0 with compact presets, custom opener, collapsed sampling pill (default 25%), p95 pinned, telemetry hooks. Follow-ups: a11y checklist from ravi, debounce/URL/query work from noor, prototype from liam, and copy A for tooltip. ravi (a11y): I'll share the a11y checklist by tomorrow: focus order, listbox semantics, aria-live phrasing for chart updates, slider aria values, tooltip semantics, contrast fixes. liam (frontend): I'll have a working prototype (no backend) by Wed. Will include the expand animation and low-density overlay. mira (design): Thanks everyone. I'll bring mock + copy A to UX sync and attach contrast specs for legend chips. :white_check_mark:
